items.title: Access the Power of Now to Experience Life More Fully | Eckhart Tolle
items.description: Eckhart Tolle is a world-revered spiritual teacher and author known for sharing practical tools that allow people to experience life more richly. We discuss, and Eckhart demonstrates, how you can access greater inner peace, authenticity, creativity, and connection in your everyday life. Eckhart also shares tools for quieting compulsive thinking, accessing inner stillness, and adopting a helpful mental vantage point when life gets challenging. We also discuss how to balance your pursuit of external goals with your spiritual growth and relationships and, in doing so, foster a deeper sense of well-being. items.title: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.description: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, I explain how nicotine affects the brain and body, including how it increases dopamine, acetylcholine and norepinephrine to boost motivation, focus and alertness, suppresses appetite and raises heart rate and blood pressure. I distinguish nicotine itself from its delivery methods — smoking, vaping, dipping and snuffing — and explain their serious health risks, why vaping is especially habit-forming and why quitting is so difficult. I also discuss science-based tools to quit smoking or vaping, including clinical hypnosis, prescription medication and nicotine replacement strategies, and how to get through the critical first week of withdrawal. Read the episode show notes at hubermanlab.com.
